hook.say: True or false? Flat maps stretch the truth. Five size facts, three seconds each. The last one fools map lovers!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Greenland is about the same size as Africa.
questions.fact: It only looks that way on Mercator maps. Africa is 14 times larger.
questions.sayAnswer: False! It only looks that way on flat maps. Africa is 14 times larger.

questions.fact: Antarctica is 14.2 million km², about 40% larger than Europe.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Antarctica is about 40 percent larger than Europe.

questions.q: Almost all of South America lies east of Florida.
questions.fact: South America sits far to the east. Nearly all of it is east of Miami.
questions.sayAnswer: True! South America sits far to the east. Nearly all of it is east of Miami.

questions.q: Brazil is bigger than the contiguous United States.
questions.fact: Brazil: 8.5 million km². The lower 48 states: 8.1 million km².
questions.sayAnswer: True! Brazil is slightly bigger than the lower 48 states put together.

questions.fact: Mexico is 1.96 million km². Alaska is 1.72 million km².
questions.sayAnswer: False! Maps inflate Alaska. Mexico is actually the bigger one.
